The latest time allowed, as "hh:mm". Earlier than `min`, the range runs
across midnight.

members.name: min
members.description: The earliest time allowed, as "hh:mm". Also where `step` counts from.

members.name: step
members.description:
In seconds, or "any". 60 when unset, so there's no seconds to fill in.
Counted from `min` when there is one.

members.name: value
members.description:
A 24-hour "hh:mm" string, with ":ss" and ".sss" when it has them. Like a
native input, the attribute is the default value and the property is the
current one, so the attribute doesn't change as the field is edited.

members.name: validationMessage
members.description:
What's wrong, as the validity message says it: the message given to
`setCustomValidity()` or `setValidity()`, or else the browser's own.
Empty while it's valid.

members.name: valueAsDate
members.description:
`value` as a `Date` on January 1, 1970, UTC, or `null` when empty, as on a
native input.

members.name: resetValidityFeedback
members.description: Clears the validity feedback without changing `validity`.

members.name: showPicker
members.description:
Opens the browser's time picker, where it has one. It's the native
input's, so it throws where that one does, such as without a user gesture.

members.description:
The value of the first pressed and enabled button. Setting it presses the
button with that value, and only that one.

members.name: values
members.description:
The value of every pressed and enabled button, in the order they appear.
Setting it presses the buttons with those values, and only those, or only
the first of them unless `multiple` is set.
